name: saas-dashboard
context: Design a SaaS analytics dashboard for enterprise teams. The audience is business analysts and managers who need real-time KPI monitoring, data visualization, and quick actions. Target platforms: desktop (primary), tablet, and mobile responsive. The interface must handle dense data while maintaining clarity and scanability.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json scale ratio and allowed font pairings
Apply color.rules.json role assignments and contrast thresholds (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text)
Use layout.rules.json grid system with defined breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)
Ensure spacing derives from Token_System spacing scale only
All interactive elements must meet WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard operable, ARIA roles, visible focus indicators
Data visualizations must not rely solely on color to convey meaning
Comply with Quality_Gate anti-AI-slop checklist: no hardcoded values, proper visual hierarchy, token-only styling

outputCriteria.format: Component composition spec with token references, layout grid definition, and interaction states
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens from Token_System
Typography follows defined scale ratio from typography.rules.json
Layout uses grid columns and breakpoints from layout.rules.json
Every interactive component documents hover, focus, active, and disabled states
No raw/hardcoded visual values present in output
accessibilityRequirements: All text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
Large text and UI components meet 3:1 contrast ratio
All interactive elements are keyboard accessible with no keyboard traps
Focus indicators visible with 3:1 contrast against surrounding area
Data charts include text alternatives or accessible descriptions

examples.description: KPI card organism using token-based styling and responsive grid
examples.output:
Organism: KPICardGrid
  Layout: grid(columns: var(--grid-columns), gap: var(--space-md))
  Children:
    - Molecule: KPICard
        bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
        border: var(--border-default)
        radius: var(--radius-lg)
        padding: var(--space-lg)
        Content:
          - Atom: Text(role=label, token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary)
          - Atom: Text(role=value, token=typography.heading.lg, color=color.text.primary)
          - Atom: TrendIndicator(color=color.feedback.success | color.feedback.error)
        States: default, hover(shadow: var(--shadow-md)), focus-within(outline: var(--color-focus-ring))
acceptanceCriteria: Uses only semantic token references for all visual properties
Grid layout references layout.rules.json column system
Hover and focus states are explicitly defined
Component hierarchy follows atomic design (atoms inside molecules inside organisms)
